title: AF-Mamba: Efficient Long-Term Signal Modeling for Early Prediction of Atrial Fibrillation Onset
abstract: arXiv:2609.06984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with increased risks of stroke and heart failure. The growing availability of wearable and portable ECG monitoring enables continuous assessment of cardiac rhythm outside clinical settings. Predicting AF before its onset could provide additional lead time for timely clinical assessment and potentially improve the management of patients at risk of AF-related complications. This study focuses on predicting AF onset one hour in advance using long-term RR intervals (RRIs). To address this challenge, we propose a deep learning architecture that integrates temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for local features encoding with Mamba, a selective state-space model capable of long-range sequence modeling. translated_title: AF-Mamba：用于房颤发作早期预测的高效长期信号建模
translated_abstract: 心房颤动（AF）是最常见的心律失常，与中风和心力衰竭的风险增加相关。可穿戴和便携式心电（ECG）监测设备的日益普及，使得在临床环境之外对心律进行持续评估成为可能。在房颤发作前进行预测可以为及时的临床评估提供额外的提前时间，并有可能改善存在房颤相关并发症风险患者的管理。本研究专注于利用长期RR间期（RRIs）提前一小时预测房颤发作。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种深度学习架构，该架构将用于局部特征编码的时序卷积网络（TCN）与Mamba（一种能够进行长程序列建模的选择性状态空间模型）相结合。这种TCN-Mamba混合设计使得在一小时输入窗口上进行高效的训练和推理成为可能，克服了Transformer的二次方扩展限制以及循环模型的局限性
tldr: 提出了一种融合时序卷积网络与Mamba状态空间模型的混合架构AF-Mamba，能够基于一小时长期RR间期信号高效预测房颤发作，突破了Transformer二次方扩展的限制。
